briefdescription.para: High-level wrapper around RocksDB TransactionDB for MVCC support.

detaileddescription.para: Manages LSM-tree configuration, WAL, transactions, blob storage, and iterator safety. The wrapper is read-safe and write-safe under its internal locking discipline, but it must not be copied and should only be moved while no concurrent operations are active.

simplesect.para: Move construction and move assignment are only safe during initialization or teardown, not while other threads are using the wrapper.
